label: Clos Lucé
region: Centre Val de Loire (Indre et Loire)
summary: Manor house at Amboise, called Cloux in the sixteenth century, where Leonardo lived from about 1516 or 1517 and died on 2 May 1519.

claims.statement: Modern coordinates of the site as given by a web gazetteer or encyclopedia page found by search.

claims.statement: Antonio de Beatis records a visit to Leonardo at Amboise in October 1517 (e-beatis), and Leonardo's will of 23 April 1519 is dated at Cloux (e-will). The 'Cloux' designation in the will is from the draft and is not checked here.
